excerpt.zh: [This.GetRulerTitle][This.GetRulerName]承诺将节俭并严格控制开支，保证[Root.GetName]在其任期结束时会拥有至少£energy£ 1000的能源，并因此当选。
excerpt.en: [This.GetRulerTitle] [This.GetRulerName] was elected on a platform of thrift and carefully deliberated spending, guaranteeing that the [Root.GetName] will enjoy reserves of at least £energy£ 1000 Energy Credits by the end of their reign.
